subject: general
question: The ________ range is bounded by the Satpura range on the south and the Aravalis on the northwest.
solution:
The correct option is **__Vindhyan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Vindhyan ****range** is bounded by the Satpura range on the south and the Aravalis on the northwest. 
 
• The Western Ghats mountain range, the **Satpura Range,** the **Vindhya Range**, and the **Aravalli Range** all encircle the **Deccan Plateau **on its western, southern, northern, and western edges, respectively.
 
• The Vindhyan range stretches from **Sasaram **in the east to **Jobat **and **Chittorgarh **in the west. The Aravallis are to the west of the range, while the Central highlands are to the south.
 
• The mountain serves as a water barrier separating the** Ganga basin** from the** peninsular plateau's river basins**.
 
• Gujarat in the west and Chattisgarh in the east are separated by the Satpura mountains. The **Vindhyas **and these mountains are contiguous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Deccan Plateau** is a vast plateau in southern and central India that is bordered by the Satpura Range to the south and the Aravalis to the northwest.
 
• The Vindhya's precise boundaries are ill-defined, and historically, the title applied to a number of diverse hills ranges in central India, notably the** Satpura Range.**
 
• **Aravali** crosses the states of** Rajasthan, Haryana, and Gujarat**, as well as the provinces of **Punjab** and** Sindh in Pakistan**. The **Banas and Luni rivers** originate here. The highest mountain in the Aravallis is **Guru Shikhar**.
 
• A mountain range in the Lesser Himalayas is called** Pir Panjal**. It crosses the states of Himachal Pradesh and Jammu & Kashmir. Two significant peaks in this area are** Deo Tibba **and **Indrasan**.
 
• The Great Boundary Fault divides the Aravalis from the Vindhya mountains in the Central Highlands, sometimes referred to as the **Madhya Bharat plateau.**
 
• During the 1962 Chinese attack, the Kailash Range served as the battleground, with pivotal engagements occurring at **Rezang La and Gurung Hill**.
 
• The** Sivalik Hills**, sometimes referred to as the Shivalik Hills and **Churia Hills**, are a mountain range of the outer Himalayas that spans the northern regions of the Indian subcontinent for a distance of around 2,400 km from the Indus River eastward near to the** Brahmaputra River**. During the 1962 Chinese attack.
 
• On the southern tip of the **Kathiawar Peninsula** in the western Gujarat state in central India is the **Gir Range**, a low mountain range. The range is incredibly rough, sloping gradually inland to the north and steeply into the sea to the south. From it, a low, slender, dissected range extends northward, rising to Gorakhnath (3,665 feet [1,117 metres] high; thought to be an extinct volcano) in the vast Girnar Hills. The Sivalik Hills, sometimes referred to as the Shivalik Hills and Churia Hills, are a mountain range of the outer Himalayas that spans the northern regions of the Indian subcontinent for a distance of around 2,400 km from the Indus River eastward near to the Brahmaputra River. The 1962 **Chinese Civil War **took place in the Kailash Range.
